messages:
Maria: FYI customer ACME (ticket #4523) reports tail latency on /v1/chat.function_call — p95 went 220ms -> 360ms, p99 980ms -> 1.8s in us-west-2. Attaching req-id and a minimal repro below.
Jamal: Can you paste req-id + minimal curl repro and which route exactly?
Maria: req-id: r-0a1b2c3d, route: chat.function_call.v1, region: us-west-2. Repro:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.function_call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Get customer info"}],"tools":[{"name":"getCustomer","params_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id"]}}]}'
```
Maria: Our logs show schema_validate_ms ~800-1200ms for the large tool response bodies on that route.
eng-runtime-bot: alert: p99_latency > 1s on chat.function_call.v1 in us-west-2 (rolling 15m).
Jamal: Correlating APM traces — schema validation timing aligns with the p99 spikes. Any recent changes to the validator?
Sylvia: Eng-ML merged PR #987 two days ago that tightened validation. It calls ajv.compile on the hot path and does not cache compiled schemas — looks like a compile-per-request pattern.
Oliver: That explains it — compiling AJV schemas per request will blow out the tail for large or complex schemas.
Kai: Customer impact: tool calls intermittently time out/fail. Need immediate mitigation and customer comms.
Maria: Can we toggle validation off per-tenant or route as a temporary measure? Customer needs ETA.
Jamal: Immediate options: 1) flip feature flag validate_tool_outputs=false for affected tenants/routes, 2) add an in-memory LRU cache for compiled schemas, 3) hotfix to precompile on worker start. Which is fastest?
Sylvia: Flag flip is fastest and reversible. I'll prepare the toggle and submit a patch to switch to cached compile.
Oliver: Also add metrics: schema_cache_hit, schema_compile_ms, schema_validate_ms so we can measure impact.
eng-sre-bot: Runbook applied: increased request timeout to 5s for chat.function_call.v1 for 10m to reduce user-visible timeouts.
Jamal: Opened PR #1012 (LRU + metrics). Deploying canary (canary-01) with 1/10 pods to validate.
Maria: For customer workaround can we accept an opt-out header X-Disable-Validation: 1? If so I'll share as a temporary measure.
Sylvia: We can add gateway-level support for that header, but gate it for non-enterprise customers; enterprise tenants must be whitelisted. I'll implement the guard.
Jamal: Canary metrics coming in: schema_validate_ms median dropped from ~420ms to ~12ms; p99 decreased ~600ms on canary pods.
Maria: Customer confirms improved latency on routed requests but still sees occasional spikes.
Oliver: Likely cold-cache compiles on first-seen schemas. We need warmup. Sylvia, can we precompile top schemas at startup?
Sylvia: Yes. I'll add a startup precompile using the top 200 schemas from historical usage and an async background compiler for new schemas — PR #1023. ETA EOD.
Kai: Maria, please send a concise customer note: we found a validation compile hot-path causing tail latency; we've applied a temporary flag and deployed a cached-compiler fix; monitoring ongoing.
Maria: Sent to customer: "Pushed a fix; monitoring p99 recovery. If you still see issues send req-id." :thumbsup:
Jamal: After 1h of canary and green metrics we rolled PR #1012 to 50% then 100%. Post-roll p95 ~240ms, p99 ~480ms — back to pre-regression numbers.
Oliver: Follow-ups: ENG-ML to ship precompile + size cap on schemas; ENG-RUNTIME to expose cache metrics and lint against ajv.compile on hot path; SUPPORT to update ticket and customer comms.
Sylvia: Note: very large schemas (>50KB) are still costly to validate; we'll add a schema-size cap and a lightweight shape-check fallback to avoid long validation.
Kai: Assign follow-ups in tracker: ENG-ML #453 (precompile + cap), ENG-RUNTIME #454 (metrics + lint), SUPPORT #455 (customer notes).
Maria: Updated ticket and filed a support postmortem with timeline and repro. Customer acknowledged and asked to be notified when permanent fix lands.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy: PR #1012 merged and rolled (deploy id 4223344601).
Jamal: Post-roll metrics stable. p99 restored. Closing escalation; create postmortem and dashboard.
Support-bot: Thread closed by Maria at 4223344599
